call.text: The authors state that the theoretical latency of 160 ms is achieved by designing a streaming, hierarchical architecture with an acoustic delay of 2 during pretraining and an acoustic delay of 1 during finetuning, which together result in the 160 ms figure【MOSHI:5.3:c083】. The authors also report that the practical latency is about 200 ms, which is higher than the 230 ms average response time measured in natural conversations across 10 languages【MOSHI:1:c005】【MOSHI:abstract:c002】.
